samples.gold:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  username TEXT,
  password TEXT,
  first_names TEXT,
  last_names TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  birth_date TEXT,
  profile_picture TEXT,
  sex INTEGER,
  reset_key TEXT,
  country_id INTEGER,
  countries_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (countries_id) REFERENCES countries(id)
);

CREATE TABLE countries (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  male_demonym TEXT,
  female_demonym TEXT,
  flag_image TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE devices (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  brand TEXT,
  type TEXT,
  user_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE books (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT,
  isbn TEXT,
  pages INTEGER,
  publication_year INTEGER,
  edition_year INTEGER,
  synopsis TEXT,
  cover_image TEXT,
  pdf TEXT,
  publisher_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (publisher_id) REFERENCES publishers(id)
);

CREATE TABLE publishers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  logo TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE authors (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  full_name TEXT,
  birth_date TEXT,
  image TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE genres (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  rating INTEGER,
  comment TEXT,
  review_date TEXT,
  user_id INTEGER,
  book_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(id)
);

CREATE TABLE books_authors (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  book_id INTEGER,
  author_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(id)
);

CREATE TABLE books_genres (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  book_id INTEGER,
  genre_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (genre_id) REFERENCES genres(id)
);
